 UNTRUSTED text (a log line, a peer's report, a source excerpt) send it as a file or on stdin instead: pij send <id> --body-file <path|-> — a         
 double-quoted body is expanded by YOUR shell before pij ever runs, so backticks and $( ) in it execute. To confirm your binding, run: pij phonehome
